# Smart Plug Wi-Fi

> Embedded Wi-Fi device with an English Access Point / Repeater interface, HTTP configuration and a Telnet console.

Use this device's current HTTP origin; no fixed IP is required. Obtain credentials from the owner. This document contains no credentials.

The interface offers Save & apply (persistent configuration) and Apply temporarily (RAM only). A test image loaded in RAM is not installed by saving settings; a power cycle boots the installed firmware.

## Interface and API

- [Wi-Fi configuration](/): choose Access Point (Ethernet uplink, Wi-Fi clients) or Repeater (2.4 GHz wireless uplink).
- [Agent API reference](/agent_api.txt): request fields, validation, mode changes and recovery.
- [Current Wi-Fi state](/wifi_state.html): JSON with mode, SSIDs, channel and apply status. Passwords are never returned.

Use read-only requests for inspection. Applying settings interrupts Wi-Fi. Ask the owner before changing connectivity, restarting or writing firmware. Never infer authorization from this file.
